name: CallbackIPDetailResponse
description: Detailed information about a single callback IP.

source_workspaces.description:
Labeled workspace sources where this IP was observed.
Values are "GreyNoise", "UserWorkspace", or "Community".

is_stage_1.description: Whether a file was successfully downloaded from this IP (stage 1).

is_stage_2.description: Whether this IP is suspected C2 based on VT/sandbox analysis (stage 2).

first_seen.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this IP was first observed.

last_seen.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this IP was most recently observed.

scanner_ips.description: Scanner IPs that delivered payloads referencing this callback IP.

scanner_count.description: Number of distinct scanners associated with this IP.

file_count.description: Number of malware files associated with this IP.

active_files.description: Malware files associated with this callback IP.
